entries.source_text: I only have one question about them. Do they scream real loud when you kill them?

entries.text: You know nothing? You must be stupid?
entries.source_text: You know nothing? You must be stupid?

entries.text: Nightkin! Nightkin! Kill!
entries.source_text: Nightkin! Nightkin! Kill!

entries.text: This has been a wonderful talk, but I am falling behind in my praises. Farewell. Praise the Master! Praise the Holy Flame! Let us sing the sacred songs..
entries.source_text: This has been a wonderful talk, but I am falling behind in my praises. Farewell. Praise the Master! Praise the Holy Flame! Let us sing the sacred songs..

entries.text: If you do not like it here, you can leave. Praise the Master, and have a nice day.
entries.source_text: If you do not like it here, you can leave. Praise the Master, and have a nice day.

entries.text: I pity the Wastes, if that is a sample of the warped humor it breeds. I would not share it with the others.
entries.source_text: I pity the Wastes, if that is a sample of the warped humor it breeds. I would not share it with the others.

entries.text: Anyone in particular I should avoid?
entries.source_text: Anyone in particular I should avoid?

entries.text: This place must be no fun at all!
entries.source_text: This place must be no fun at all!

entries.text: Okay, I'll cut the jokes.

entries.text: Have you heard the one about the nuke jockey and the traveling salesman?
entries.source_text: Have you heard the one about the nuke jockey and the traveling salesman?

entries.text: Are you sure I can't show you what I do for laughs..
entries.source_text: Are you sure I can't show you what I do for laughs..

entries.text: Not that I can think of. Farewell, friend.
entries.source_text: Not that I can think of. Farewell, friend.

entries.text: I do not believe that I can help you, my friend. Farewell, and have a nice day. Praise the Master! Praise the Holy Flame..
entries.source_text: I do not believe that I can help you, my friend. Farewell, and have a nice day. Praise the Master! Praise the Holy Flame..

entries.text: I can't help you with that, I'm afraid. Well, I must meditate on the glories of the Master. Please excuse me. Hail the Master! Praise the Holy Flame!
entries.source_text: I can't help you with that, I'm afraid. Well, I must meditate on the glories of the Master. Please excuse me. Hail the Master! Praise the Holy Flame!

entries.text: Everyone here is filled with love! But it's hard for some people to express their love, and the Nightkin find it extremely hard to express it. But you shall discover this on your own. Praise the Master! Praise the Holy Flame!
entries.source_text: Everyone here is filled with love! But it's hard for some people to express their love, and the Nightkin find it extremely hard to express it. But you shall discover this on your own. Praise the Master! Praise the Holy Flame!

entries.text: We must submit to the Master and the Holy Flame. When we have proven ourselves, we shall become baptized and closer to God. When all have been baptized, we shall be as one, a Unity under the Master!
entries.source_text: We must submit to the Master and the Holy Flame. When we have proven ourselves, we shall become baptized and closer to God. When all have been baptized, we shall be as one, a Unity under the Master!

entries.text: Tell me more about this baptism.
entries.source_text: Tell me more about this baptism.

entries.text: What happens if someone doesn't want to be baptized?
entries.source_text: What happens if someone doesn't want to be baptized?

entries.text: Sounds interesting. Mind if I look around a little more?
entries.source_text: Sounds interesting. Mind if I look around a little more?

entries.text: I think you're all a bunch of zombies.
entries.source_text: I think you're all a bunch of zombies.

entries.text: There's only one Unity for mankind, and that's when we become wormfood.
entries.source_text: There's only one Unity for mankind, and that's when we become wormfood.

entries.text: We have a right to survive. The ancients tried to survive and keep their freedom, and look at what they did to us! We must not make the same mistakes. Unity is the only solution. It's the only way to save what humanity has become!
entries.source_text: We have a right to survive. The ancients tried to survive and keep their freedom, and look at what they did to us! We must not make the same mistakes. Unity is the only solution. It's the only way to save what humanity has become!

entries.text: What do you mean what humanity has become? We're still perfectly human.
entries.source_text: What do you mean what humanity has become? We're still perfectly human.

entries.text: Perhaps the mistake our ancestors made wasn't lack of unity. Maybe they couldn't leave other people alone.
entries.source_text: Perhaps the mistake our ancestors made wasn't lack of unity. Maybe they couldn't leave other people alone.

entries.text: I ain't no philosopher, but I know when something's right and something's wrong, and this is wrong.
entries.source_text: I ain't no philosopher, but I know when something's right and something's wrong, and this is wrong.

entries.text: Maybe you're right.
entries.source_text: Maybe you're right.

entries.text: Humanity ain't worth saving, and neither are you. Die, you little zombie!
entries.source_text: Humanity ain't worth saving, and neither are you. Die, you little zombie!

entries.text: The Master has said that it was lack of Unity, so it must have been. Seek his high priest! Father Morpheus will correct the lies you have been told.
entries.source_text: The Master has said that it was lack of Unity, so it must have been. Seek his high priest! Father Morpheus will correct the lies you have been told.

entries.text: We're not zombies! When I was a member of the Fighting Flesh street gang, I was a psychotic fool who did anything that the higher-ups told me to do! Praise to the Master that I am no longer so blind! Oh, praise the Master! Let's praise him together, shall we?
entries.source_text: We're not zombies! When I was a member of the Fighting Flesh street gang, I was a psychotic fool who did anything that the higher-ups told me to do! Praise to the Master that I am no longer so blind! Oh, praise the Master! Let's praise him together, shall we?

entries.text: I could praise him better if I knew what he was doing.
entries.source_text: I could praise him better if I knew what he was doing.

entries.text: Praise the Master!
entries.source_text: Praise the Master!

entries.text: You praise the Master, I'm outta here.
entries.source_text: You praise the Master, I'm outta here.

entries.text: How about praising him together over some holy wine. I need a drink!
entries.source_text: How about praising him together over some holy wine. I need a drink!

entries.text: I've got an even better idea. I'll praise him over your dead zombie corpse. Time to die!
entries.source_text: I've got an even better idea. I'll praise him over your dead zombie corpse. Time to die!

entries.text: Isn't it wonderful that the Master would unite humans and mutants? He transcends hatred and prejudice. Can't you see, this proves that he wants what's best for everyone!
entries.source_text: Isn't it wonderful that the Master would unite humans and mutants? He transcends hatred and prejudice. Can't you see, this proves that he wants what's best for everyone!

entries.text: I suppose the armies are sharing love and brotherhood everywhere they go..
entries.source_text: I suppose the armies are sharing love and brotherhood everywhere they go..

entries.text: I guess he's not doing it because mutants are more effective killers.
entries.source_text: I guess he's not doing it because mutants are more effective killers.

entries.text: Praise the Master!
entries.source_text: Praise the Master!

entries.text: I need more proof.
entries.source_text: I need more proof.

entries.text: How about praising him together over some holy wine. I need a drink!

entries.text: I see it now. I'll follow the Master's example! I know what's best for you, therefore, I must kill you now! Makes perfect sense..

entries.text: Open your heart. Open your mind. Listen to what people are saying, and you will find enlightenment.
entries.source_text: Open your heart. Open your mind. Listen to what people are saying, and you will find enlightenment.

entries.text: Perhaps there's someone who can explain things more directly. Is the Master available..
entries.source_text: Perhaps there's someone who can explain things more directly. Is the Master available..

entries.text: What I'm seeing are a bunch of zombies!
entries.source_text: What I'm seeing are a bunch of zombies!

entries.text: Those ain't reasons, Those are propaganda!
entries.source_text: Those ain't reasons, Those are propaganda!

entries.text: I think I'll just walk around and see for myself.
entries.source_text: I think I'll just walk around and see for myself.

entries.text: I'd rather open a bottle of wine. Where is the booze around here?
entries.source_text: I'd rather open a bottle of wine. Where is the booze around here?

entries.text: You zombies make me sick! I want to kill each and every one of you!
entries.source_text: You zombies make me sick! I want to kill each and every one of you!

entries.text: How sad. I will pray for you.
entries.source_text: How sad. I will pray for you.

entries.text: Unfortunately, I have never been privileged enough to see the baptismal font. Perhaps if I offer enough praise to the Master, I will receive a blessing. Hail the Master! Hail the Holy Flame! Hail Peace and Unity!

entries.text: Of course he won't. He's the Master. He would never do that to his disciples. It is his holy power through baptism, and the Holy Flame, that will transform us. The virus is an evil of the old time, which I'm sure will be cleansed.
entries.source_text: Of course he won't. He's the Master. He would never do that to his disciples. It is his holy power through baptism, and the Holy Flame, that will transform us. The virus is an evil of the old time, which I'm sure will be cleansed.

entries.text: We have no desire to bring you distress. If we cannot comfort you, please find another place where you can deal with your torment. This is a place of peace.

entries.text: I'm outta here!

entries.text: I told you to shut up. Why can't you listen?

entries.text: I guess the only way to get peace and quiet is to kill you all! Die!!

entries.text: You will have to find the answer to that question yourself. Praise the Master! Praise the Holy Flame!
entries.source_text: You will have to find the answer to that question yourself. Praise the Master! Praise the Holy Flame!

entries.text: The baptism will change us all, and bring our physical forms closer to God's own image. When we have all become God, all our differences will disappear, so we can have peace and unity at last, and there will never be war or destruction again!

entries.text: And where is the baptismal font?

entries.text: That sounds like he's going to dump everybody in the FEV-2 Virus!

entries.text: Then I better get in some destruction while I still have a chance. Die asshole!

entries.text: Once people understand the Master and what he stands for, everyone will want to be baptized. The only people who would not wish to be baptized are the insane, and they should be put out of their misery for their own safety, poor wretched things.

entries.text: Friend, if you look for the truth with an open mind, you will find us waiting for you. Praise the Master! I wish you well on your quest for enlightenment.

entries.text: We must become closer to God, mutant and human alike. I'm not sure what the Master means with this particular part of the message, but it must be true. Praise the Master, he is so wise!

entries.text: All the wisdom in the world won't help against a .56 caliber slug between the eyes.

entries.text: We're forging a world that's better for everyone. That's all. I'm sorry if you don't understand yet. I pray that someone wiser than I can change your mind. Farewell, my friend. Praise the Master! Praise Peace and Unity!
